title: Extra Slabs
description: Add's slabs from blocks that wouldnt be normal
body:
Puts blocks into a slab variant!

You might be asking: Why is this useful?

and theres where i say "what if you need smoother terrain", "what if you need smooth builds", "what if you want half blocks of literally anything for detailing"

this mod adds a slab version of single vanilla block. you can now make way smoother hills, better looking paths, cleaner walls, stairs that actually match your builds, and all kinds of extra detail work that normal slabs couldnt do before.

so if u need smoother builds, smoother terrain, or just a shitload of extra slabs, this is the mod for you.

Curseforge Page: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/extra-slabs
